motivation: r3 (c_ref=1.0) and r4 (c_ref=1e-9) have bitwise-identical aggregate 0.03467297950736765 because both reference values collapse the sinc^2 k-space correction to the identity. The configuration recorded as the 'r4 best recipe' therefore never exercised k-space correction at all; it is fourth-order temporal plus restriction only. The genuine r1 x r4 combination (temporal_order=4 + per-record c_max correction + match_fine_grid_restriction) has never been run and needs zero solver changes.

excluded_from_baseline.reason: Not comparable: records_per_family=1 versus 3, and temporal_order / match_fine_grid_restriction / maximum_instance_relative_l2 are all null, indicating an older script revision whose gate never evaluated per-record error. Its lower aggregate reflects a smaller, easier sample rather than a better configuration.

shared_arm_settings.device_rationale: The probe's value is comparability with the 0.0347 aggregate and 0.0377 marmousi baselines, measured on cpu/float64. cuda would drop to float32 per scripts/probe_kspace_saved_grid.py:166 and forfeit the gate anchor.

readout_rules.E1: Arm A passes all three gates -> the proper combination is the recipe; freeze it and record the corrected provenance of the r3/r4 identity collapse.
readout_rules.E2: Arm A fails but the quantile direction is monotone and B or C passes -> the homogeneous scalar reference is the binding constraint; open a separate preregistration for a banded or spatially varying reference.
readout_rules.E3: No arm passes and the quantile direction is flat or adverse -> the homogeneous scalar reference is exhausted; promote the banded/spatially varying reference to the main line.
readout_rules.honesty: Report pass/fail exactly as measured. A gate is never revised after seeing results.

failure_signal: Any arm that raises, produces a non-finite aggregate, or exceeds 3x the r4 baseline runtime mean (29.1 s/record) is reported as a failed arm rather than retried with altered settings.

budget.thread_isolation: OMP_NUM_THREADS=16 per arm. Verified necessary: neither the probe nor solver_kspace.py calls set_num_threads, so each process would otherwise contend for all 72 cores.

disk_guard.artifacts: KB-scale JSON only; no checkpoints written

rollback: Revert the single probe argparse addition. No checkpoint, dataset, or head-side (r16_dscp) artifact is touched.
out_of_scope: No r16_dscp head change. The r4e13 cross-record scaling probe proceeds independently under its own frozen E1/E2/E3 readout.
